items.title: IDR Data Reporting – Due 31 Aug 2026
items.desc: Submit Internal Dispute Resolution data for Jan–Jun 2026 via ASIC Regulatory Portal by 31 August 2026. Updated handbook includes changes for BNPL, digital assets and mutual risk products.

items.title: FS70 / FS71 Lodgement – Due 31 Oct 2026
items.desc: Annual financial statements and audit report must be lodged within 4 months of 30 June FY close. Engage auditor now. (CA 989A–D, AFSL Condition)

items.title: Digital Asset AFSL – No-Action Period Expired 30 Jun 2026
items.desc: ASIC's no-action position for digital asset businesses expired 30 June 2026. Firms providing financial services involving digital asset products without an AFSL now risk breaching financial services laws.

items.title: Digital Assets Framework – AFSL Applications Open from Apr 2027
items.desc: Corporations Amendment (Digital Assets Framework) Act 2026 passed. DAP and TCP operators can lodge AFSL applications from April 2027. Full compliance required by October 2027.

items.title: ASIC 2026 Enforcement Priorities – Private Credit & Reporting
items.desc: ASIC doubled investigations and court proceedings. Focus on private credit practices, financial reporting misconduct, insurance claims handling, and misleading pricing. Review internal practices.

items.title: Tranche 2 Compliance Officer Notification – 12 Aug 2026
items.desc: Newly regulated Tranche 2 entities that enrolled by 29 Jul 2026 must notify AUSTRAC of their AML/CTF Compliance Officer by 12 August 2026 (14 days after enrolment deadline).

items.title: New TTR and SMR Reporting Forms – Live from 1 Jul 2026
items.desc: AUSTRAC's new threshold transaction report and suspicious matter report forms are now available. Existing entities can transition anytime; old forms remain valid until 30 March 2029.

items.title: Unified AML/CTF Program – Now In Effect
items.desc: Reformed AML/CTF Act in force since 31 March 2026. All reporting entities must operate unified, outcomes-focused programs replacing the old Part A/Part B structure. Ongoing CDD applies.

items.title: AUSTRAC Risk Snapshots – AI and Virtual Assets
items.desc: AUSTRAC's May 2026 ML/TF/PF risk snapshots highlight growing AI and crypto threats. Ensure risk-based AML/CTF frameworks account for these emerging risks in your program.

items.title: AML/CTF Amendment Bill 2026 – AUSTRAC Powers Expanding
items.desc: New bill proposes powers for AUSTRAC CEO to restrict high-risk products and delivery channels (e.g. crypto ATMs). Monitor for passage and assess impact on fund operations.

items.title: Automated Bidding Compliance Bulletin – 5 Aug 2026
items.desc: AER issued guidance on automated bidding and third-party bidding services in the NEM. Market participants must maintain oversight, conduct due diligence on providers and retain contingency plans.

items.title: Half-Yearly Breach Reports – Due 31 Aug 2026
items.desc: AER-regulated entities must submit compliance and breach reports by 31 August 2026 covering the first half of 2026. Collate H1 data and submit via AER portal.

items.title: Rate of Return Instrument Review – Final Dec 2026
items.desc: AER's 2026 RORI review underway. Final decision expected December 2026. Will set allowed returns on capital for regulated electricity and gas networks for the next regulatory cycle.

items.title: AER 2025-26 Compliance & Enforcement Report Released
items.desc: AER published its latest compliance and enforcement activities report. Review findings relevant to any portfolio companies with energy retail authorisations or network connections.

items.title: Exemptions Guidelines 2026 Review – Consultation Ongoing
items.desc: AER's review of the Exemptions Guidelines to align with flexible trading reforms is ongoing. Proposes reduced regulatory burden for commercial embedded network retrofits.
